user.title: Connect BLUETTI on your local network
user.description: Read-only local telemetry for Elite 30 V2. Choose Automatic when Home Assistant runs on the UPS’s Linux router with network administration permission: the integration manages three UPS-only rules itself. Choose Manual to keep existing router configuration. Reserve the UPS IP in DHCP. No cloud account or Bluetooth.

network.title: Configure this UPS’s network
network.description: The integration will manage three rules for {device_ip} to {receiver_ip} in its own table. Confirm only if Home Assistant runs on the router used by the UPS. It may reconnect only the data channel and rolls back new rules if two valid reports do not arrive within three minutes. UPS power, AC/DC outputs, other clients’ DNS and existing firewall rules stay untouched. No additional service is required.
